role: Generator architectural analysis, not independent acceptance

boundaries.decision: Scan all published operation records under held flock. Any running/cancel_requested/unknown or unrecognized status blocks replacement, even when pointer is null.

boundaries.publication: session outstanding pointer before child dispatch
boundaries.decision: Existing non-null-pointer refusal remains. No inference that absence of child receipt means a safe restart.

boundaries.publication: result before terminal operation, terminal operation before pointer clear
boundaries.decision: Result with nonterminal operation is refused. Completed operation requires matching correlated result. Any retained outstanding pointer refuses replacement; no automatic clearing or fabricated completion.
Matching terminal records permit clean restart. Terminated/rejected operations require no child result; result orphans/mismatches refuse. All prior files remain untouched.

boundaries.publication: metadata generation reservation before session generation
boundaries.decision: New explicit private metadata generation must match durable session generation before allocating another incarnation. Interrupted mismatch refuses. Failed startup with coherently reserved generation consumes it; subsequent clean replacement increments rather than resets.

boundaries.publication: idle in-memory state versus durable state before next submit
boundaries.decision: Before any otherwise admissible new dispatch, compare actual metadata/session bytes as parsed values to owned in-memory state and recheck record consistency. Duplicate-ID/busy/refusal paths retain their existing semantics.

limits: No recovery override or state repair introduced.
Old B2 development commands do not replace independently authored B3 crash regression and renewed review.
